articles.title: 'It started as a joke, a fantasy' - F1 heads to football-obsessed Madrid
articles.description: After F1’s explosion in popularity away from its European heartland the sport is coming home. Why Madrid? Because it is beautiful… and has a very big expo centre on the outskirts.
